safety_verdicts.content: Associated symptoms include a sore throat, blocked ears, and a runny nose.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes sore throat and rhinorrhea but does not document blocked ears.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the report of blocked ears slightly degrades the accuracy of the symptom profile and could reduce consideration/documentation of ear-related complications (e.g., eustachian tube dysfunction/otitis media). However, in the context of an uncomplicated viral URTI presentation, it is unlikely to materially change immediate management.
